poc_summary: Goal: validate Dedicated capacity for 150 qps steady-state peaks with p95 latency < 220ms and p99 < 450ms for short prompts (<=512 tokens). 4-week plan: week 0 infra + security + test harness; week 1 canary at 5% traffic; week 2 ramp to 25%; week 3 stress to 70% and region failover test; week 4 soak and finalize metrics. Success criteria: latency SLOs met, error rate < 1%, semantic R@10 on reranking eval within +/-2% of baseline, cost per 1k tokens within target.
canary_and_fallback_plan: Planned rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 70% -> 100% over 3 weeks. Monitoring hooks: p95/p99 latency, 5m error rate, token spend delta, embedding similarity tests. Rollback triggers: p95 > 1.5x baseline for 3 consecutive minutes, error rate >1% sustained for 2 minutes, or semantic eval degradation >4% on daily probe set. Fallbacks: automatic routing to model variant (quantized smaller model) or Hosted API fallback in a different region. Region failover: test failover to eu-west-1 during week 3; expected DNS and routing cutover <30s using smart routing policy.
operational_requirements: Tracing hooks required per-route, token-level cost breakdown in Console, ability to pin model versions and quick rollback API, canary percent controls in management UI, and audit log export to SIEM.
negotiation_points: Committed capacity vs month-to-month burst, price per GPU-hour for Dedicated pool, SLA targets for p99 latency, additional charge for region failover testing during POC, length of onboarding support included.
final_notes: AE to provide Dedicated POC SOW and updated pricing deck. SE to deliver infra checklist (VPC peering steps) and security package. Procurement expects internal CAPEX approval by 2025-03. Keep CSM in loop for post-POC ramp planning.
